snakes.note: HIDDEN SNAKE. Appears as ordinary carved stonework until triggered. Head position randomised within the Temple zone per game seed.
Replaced Old Root. Hypnotist — pawn walks in voluntarily, no strike. See Art Bible section 10.
Wide head NOT enabled. Rebalanced ladders already give a 46% appearance rate at 4 players.

ladders.note: HIDDEN LADDER. Same hint pattern as the hidden snake — teaches 'pattern = reward' early, so the hidden snake later subverts it. Bottom randomised per game seed.
Deposits at 95, in the shrine zone, past the King's reach from below. Must stay VISIBLE — its value is that everyone can see it and races for it.

no snake tail equals any ladder bottom
no ladder top equals any ladder bottom (no chains)
no snake tail equals any snake head (no chains)

no snake head or ladder bottom on square 100

balanceReference.note: King drop severity has NO effect on game length. NOTE: with the rebalanced ladders the King already appears in 46% of 4p games, so the wide-head option is likely NO LONGER NEEDED — 69% would dilute him.
balanceReference.staleWarning: Figures predate the hidden-square proposal and any Kaal tail change. Re-run board-balance-sim.py after either is enabled.

hiddenSquares.hintPattern: Identical visual hint for both the hidden snake and the hidden ladder. This is the core trick: the early ladder teaches 'pattern = reward', the later snake weaponises that lesson.
hiddenSquares.rehideRule: Fixed within a single game (re-hides after triggering, same position). Re-randomised between games via the game seed.

overlapBand.note: EITHER may appear here. Without this overlap players learn the zoning after one game and the trick dies permanently.

openQuestions: Balance impact of randomisation is UNSIMULATED. Run board-balance-sim.py with randomised positions and check game-length variance before enabling.

openDesignQuestions: Kaal drop is 31 (74->43) but he is now the second most menacing asset. Menace should predict drop size. Proposed: move tail 43 -> 30, making it a 44 drop matching Vyra. Square 30 is free. NOT YET APPLIED.
Ladders have no identities. Eight anonymous sticks against seven named characters.
Exact-roll-to-win is untested with real players. Bounce-back on overshoot is a third option that was never simulated.
ladderLayoutNote: Rebalanced. The original set put 66% of all board furniture in the left half, with column 9 carrying almost nothing. This set spreads it to 54/46 and cuts ladder-ladder crossings from 4 to 1, while holding 4p median at 20 rolls.
